about.title: About MARKARU
about.subtitle: From our land to the world
about.intro: We connect Latin America's agriculture with buyers around the world, without intermediaries.

meaning.title: What does MARKARU mean?
meaning.body: MARKARU comes from the Quechua and Aymara word 'marka', meaning people, community and land. It is a tribute to the roots of those who work the fields in Latin America, and to our mission: bringing the fruit of their labor to the world.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: We give visibility and tools to agricultural producers in Latin America so they can connect directly with buyers around the world, with fewer intermediaries. We believe that those who feed their country and the world deserve to grow, be seen and sell on fair terms.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.body: Latin America's agriculture produces world-class food, but connecting with producers is difficult: few channels, much informality and too many intermediaries that cut into their margins. MARKARU brings together producers, exporters, freight agents, certifiers and buyers in one place, with verified profiles and tracking of every operation. We make visible those who were previously hard to find.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: MARKARU was born from a real experience. For years, its founder wanted to buy directly from farmers, but finding them was nearly impossible: there was no easy way to reach them, no channels that made them visible. And yet, they were doing — and still do — one of the most important jobs in the world: feeding an entire country, and much of the planet.
story.p2: From that frustration came a conviction: if those producers were more visible and had the right tools, they could grow without limits. MARKARU exists for that. So that the effort of every farmer stops going unnoticed and finally reaches, from our land, the world.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To become the leading agro-export platform in Latin America: expanding across the region, integrating financing, inputs and certification, and being the digital bridge that brings Latin American agriculture to the world.

cta.title: Ready to join?
cta.subtitle: Be part of the community transforming agriculture in Latin America.
